sources.title: Action: Source - Help / Dedicated server setup
Console Command List - Valve Developer Community
Source Dedicated Server Console Commands (cvarlist dump)
How can I set ban length for tf2 dedicated server?

notes: Action: Source is a standalone free Source-engine mod; its dedicated server is plain srcds. The developer's own help page gives the install (steamcmd +app_update 985050) and the start line "./srcds_run -usercon -game ahl2 +ip <ip> +map act_island +maxplayers 20 +exec server.cfg", and documents rcon_password in server.cfg - so the command channel is stock Valve Source RCON on the game port (hostport, default 27015); -usercon is a launch argument, not a cvar. Commands here are engine-level Source commands, not mod-specific: status lists players and is also the server status readout (there is no separate playerlist command). kickid takes a userid OR a Steam ID plus a reason, and the reason must NOT be quoted - srcds.com forum reports quoting the message breaks it (example given: kickid STEAM_0:1:223 Please do not swear). banid is "banid <minutes> <userid|uniqueid> {kick}" with 0 minutes = permanent; banid has no reason argument natively (a reason on ban requires SourceMod or Mani Admin Plugin), so {reason} is deliberately absent from the ban template. Bans made with banid live only in memory until writeid is run, which rewrites ahl2/cfg/banned_user.cfg; removeid unbans live and writeid must be run again to persist that. There is no motd command - Source serves motd.txt from the game folder - so motd is omitted. Uncertainty: the exact uniqueid format printed by status on this specific SDK-2013-derived build was not observed, so playerId.pattern and playerParse accept both the legacy STEAM_0:1:x form and the modern [U:1:x] form; banid and kickid accept either.
